paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.01 as of 2026-08-25, representing a 6.94 percent increase from the prior close. Over a window of 22 sessions, the stock price has decreased by 16.87 percent.

Recent SEC filings include a Form 4 filed on 2026-08-18, a Form 10-Q filed on 2026-08-14, and two Form 8-K filings on 2026-08-13, one of which announced the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. There are also 2 Form 4 filings and 11 proxy solicitation filings in total.
